```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(alarmdata)
library(PL94171)
library(tmap)
```

### New York State Map



```{r code-chunk-label}
NY_alarm <- alarm_50state_map("NY")

NY_partisan <- NY_alarm |>
  mutate(democrat_margin = round((adv_20 -arv_20)/ (adv_20 + arv_20)*100,2)) 

NY_partisan |>
  tm_shape() +
  tm_polygons(fill = "democrat_margin")
```

### Minority Spread map

```{r}
NY_Pop <- NY_alarm |>
  mutate(minority_pct = (pop-pop_white) / pop * 100)

NY_outlines <- NY_alarm |>
  group_by(cd_2020)|>
  summarize(.groups = "drop")

tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(NY_Pop) +
  tm_fill(
    "minority_pct",
    palette ="YlOrRd",
    title = "Minority %",
    id = "cd_2020",
    popup.vars = c("Total Population" = "pop", "Minority %" ="minority_pct"),
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  tm_shape(NY_outlines)+
  tm_borders(col = "black",
             lwd =2,
             group = "District Boundaries") +
  tm_layout(title = "New York Congressional Districts: Minority Population") 
```

### Cleaning Up the water

```{r}
library(tigris)
library(sf)

# 1. Download the land boundary for NY (excluding water)
# 'cb = TRUE' downloads the generalized (cleaner) coastline
ny_land <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "500k") |>
  filter(NAME == "New York") |>
  st_transform(st_crs(NY_Pop)) # Ensure the coordinate systems match

# 2. Clip your Precincts and Outlines to the land
NY_Pop_Clipped <- st_intersection(NY_Pop, ny_land)
NY_outlines_Clipped <- st_intersection(NY_outlines, ny_land)

# 3. Plot the clipped version
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(NY_Pop_Clipped) +
  tm_fill(
    "minority_pct",
    palette ="YlOrRd",
    title = "Minority %",
    id = "cd_2020",
    popup.vars = c("Total Population" = "pop", "Minority %" ="minority_pct"),
    border.alpha = 0, # Makes precinct joins invisible
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  tm_shape(NY_outlines_Clipped) +
  tm_borders(
    col = "black",
    lwd = 2,
    group = "District Boundaries"
  ) +
  tm_layout(title = "Land-Clipped NY Minority Population")
```

### Partisan tmap & cleaning up water

```{r}
NY_partisan_clipped <-st_intersection(NY_partisan, ny_land)

NY_outlines_NY24 <- NY_outlines_Clipped |>
  filter(cd_2020 == 24)

tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(NY_partisan_clipped) +
  tm_fill(
    "democrat_margin",
    palette = "RdBu",
    title = "Partisan Map",
    id = "cd_2020",
    popup.vars = c("Average Republican Vote" = "arv_20", "Average Democrat Vote" = "adv_20", "democrat margin %" = "democrat_margin"),
    border.alpha = 0,
    alpha =0.7
  ) +
  tm_shape(NY_outlines_Clipped) +
  tm_borders(
    col = "black",
    lwd = 2,
    group = "District Boundaries"
  ) +
  tm_shape(NY_outlines_NY24) +
  tm_borders(
    col = "lightyellow",
    lwd = 4,
    group = "District 24 Outline"
  )+
  tm_layout(title = "Partisan Vote Map of New York")
```
